coreResponsibility.summary: A Kaltura Player plugin that integrates the Broadpeak SmartLib SDK for CDN optimization, enabling nanoCDN functionality and streaming session management for improved video delivery.

featureOwnership: GDPR preference handling for streaming sessions
Device type and user agent configuration
dataHandling: Streaming session state (session creation, attachment, stop)
Source URL transformation (original to optimized CDN URL)
